description: Today, the Environmental League of Massachusetts Action Fund announced its endorsement of Attorney General Andrea Joy Campbell’s campaign for re-election. ELM Action cited Attorney General Campbell's aggressive enforcement against polluters, her leadership in challenging the Trump administration's rollback of environmental protections, and her commitment to environmental justice communities across the Commonwealth.

title: Environmental League of Massachusetts Action Fund Endorses Attorney General Andrea Joy Campbell for Re-Election - Andrea Joy Campbell for Attorney General
